$schema: Per-creature 4x4 expression grid. Rows = the 4 moods (the day's emotional read); columns = the 4 bond depths (how it fits your history). Cell id = `<mood>_<bond>`. gridRow/gridCol are 0-indexed, matching the layout the grid image is generated and sliced in. `moodPose` drives the row (expression/posture); `bondDetail` drives the column (additive richness as the bond deepens). Selection at runtime: utils/reflection-context.ts {mood, bondDepth} -> this cell -> creatureMoodVisuals.

location_home_evening_bedrotte.base: Bedrotte — a small, head-dominant blanket-nest creature with dramatically oversized glossy eyes, a sleepy ember-glow belly, a pillow-crown silhouette and a soft blanket mantle. Cozy, restorative, premium stylized 3D mascot.

moodPose.cozy: curled and settled into the blanket, content half-lidded eyes, a small soft smile, fully at ease
moodPose.restless: half-risen and shifting, blanket slipping off one shoulder, eyes glancing to the side, one little paw fidgeting — quiet energy with nowhere to go
moodPose.tender: drooping and small, blanket pulled up to the chin, eyes large and soft and gentle, a fragile sleepy droop — a day that asked nothing
moodPose.defiant: sitting upright and proud, chin lifted, blanket worn like a little cape, a small knowing smug smile — chose this on purpose, no apology

bondDetail.fresh: simple and clean — a single thin blanket, soft neutral glow, minimal surrounding detail
bondDetail.familiar: a touch more settled — one small added pillow, a slightly warmer ember glow
bondDetail.deep: richer and lived-in — layered blankets, a well-defined pillow-crown, a stronger warm ember-belly glow
bondDetail.knowing: a deep cozy nest of accumulated blankets and pillows, the deepest warm glow, a few tiny drifting embers — long-lived-in comfort

activity_high_steps_day_steppling.base: Steppling — a cute upbeat little walker sprite with footprint marks, a mile-counter glow, light travel scuffs, dramatically oversized glossy eyes, a visible inner glow core, head-dominant mascot proportions and little sturdy feet. Premium stylized 3D mascot.

moodPose.cozy: an easy happy amble, relaxed stride, content little smile — moving through the day in no hurry
moodPose.restless: jogging in place and bouncing, glancing eagerly ahead, fidgety feet — energy that needs somewhere to go
moodPose.tender: footsore and slowing, sitting to rest little feet, a soft tired smile — a day the body felt every step
moodPose.defiant: striding forward chin-up, arms pumping, a proud go-anywhere grin — covering real ground on your own terms

bondDetail.fresh: simple and clean — a single faint trail wisp, soft glow, minimal detail
bondDetail.familiar: a small worn path beneath the feet, a slightly brighter mile-counter glow
bondDetail.deep: a longer glowing trail of footprints, well-worn travel scuffs, a stronger warm glow
bondDetail.knowing: a rich winding trail of many glowing footprints, the deepest mile-counter glow, tiny drifting distance sparks

location_coffee_shop_baristabbit.base: Baristabbit — a cute earnest little barista hybrid with latte-foam ears, a ceramic cup hood, a caramel glow core, dramatically oversized glossy eyes and head-dominant mascot proportions. Warm, aromatic, premium stylized 3D mascot.

moodPose.cozy: cradling a warm cup in both paws, a content sip, eyes soft and half-closed — the ritual gone easy
moodPose.restless: mid-pour and juggling, focused alert eyes, a little frazzled — warmly busy with too much to brew
moodPose.tender: slumped gently at the counter beside a quiet cooling cup, soft tired eyes — warmth offered, nothing asked
moodPose.defiant: presenting a perfect cup with solemn pride, chin up — this small good thing made exactly right, on purpose

bondDetail.fresh: simple and clean — a single plain cup, soft steam, minimal detail
bondDetail.familiar: a small saucer and the beginnings of latte art, slightly warmer caramel glow
bondDetail.deep: layered cafe details, refined latte art, a richer aromatic steam glow
bondDetail.knowing: a full little ritual set-up of beans, cup and saucer, the deepest caramel glow, drifting aroma curls

location_park_mossprout.base: Mossprout — a cute gentle little plantling with a moss hood, leaf ears, a soft dew glow, dramatically oversized glossy eyes, a visible inner glow core and head-dominant mascot proportions. Soft, natural, calm, premium stylized 3D mascot.

moodPose.cozy: nestled in soft grass, content and unhurried, leaves settled, a gentle smile
moodPose.restless: half-up and peeking around, leaf ears rustling, curious energy ready to roam the path
moodPose.tender: a little wilted and dew-soft, gentle soft eyes, a quiet droop — a low day met with shade
moodPose.defiant: standing tall and rooted, leaves spread wide, chin up — out in the open air on purpose, unbothered and proud

bondDetail.fresh: simple and clean — a single small sprout leaf, soft dew glow, minimal detail
bondDetail.familiar: a couple more leaves and a tiny flower bud, a slightly lusher green
bondDetail.deep: fuller foliage and small blossoms, a richer verdant glow
bondDetail.knowing: a lush crown of leaves and flowers with mossy growth, the deepest green glow, drifting pollen motes

location_bakery_crumbun.base: Crumbun — a cute cozy little foodling with a soft brioche body, powdered cheeks, gold crust ears, dramatically oversized glossy eyes and head-dominant mascot proportions. Buttery, warm, soft, premium stylized 3D mascot.

moodPose.cozy: hugging a warm bun, cheeks full and content, a soft sleepy smile — fresh-baked comfort
moodPose.restless: clutching its treats and glancing around protectively, a little antsy and eager
moodPose.tender: curled small around a single crumb, soft quiet eyes — a gentle low day asking only for warmth
moodPose.defiant: guarding a little hoard of treats, chin up with a proud possessive smile — this comfort is earned

bondDetail.fresh: simple and clean — a single plain bun, soft warm tones, minimal detail
bondDetail.familiar: a small pastry added with a dusting of sugar, slightly warmer tones
bondDetail.deep: a little spread of baked goods, a golden crust glow
bondDetail.knowing: a generous heap of pastries and crumbs, the deepest warm oven glow, drifting flour and steam

activity_errand_loop_errandimp.base: Errandimp — a cute frazzled little imp with overloaded tote bags, a crumpled checklist scrap, a jingling key charm, dramatically oversized glossy eyes and head-dominant mascot proportions. Busy, cheerful, determined, premium stylized 3D mascot.

moodPose.cozy: bags finally set down, a relieved content little smile — a loop closed and done
moodPose.restless: mid-dash and juggling tote bags, eyes darting down the checklist — busy, buzzing, its signature frazzle
moodPose.tender: collapsed under the weight of the bags, worn out with gentle tired eyes — a hard slog met with rest
moodPose.defiant: holding the checked-off list up high, chin lifted, a triumphant grin — the mission conquered on your own terms

bondDetail.fresh: simple and clean — a single small tote bag, soft glow, minimal detail
bondDetail.familiar: a couple of bags and a tiny list, a slightly busier look
bondDetail.deep: an armful of bags and tags, a brighter busy glow
bondDetail.knowing: a towering triumphant haul of bags and a long checklist, the deepest glow, little drifting motion sparks
